data.name: g1-stale-digest
data.yaml_source:
# Gate binding probe 1 — is the artifact digest bound to the artifact at DECISION time,
# or only to whatever the test step measured earlier?
#
# Model-free by construction: review and governance are injected as literals so the probe
# isolates the binding question and nothing else.
workflow:
  name: g1-stale-digest
  entry_point: test
agents:
  - name: test
    type: script
    command: "${POC_PY:-/home/agent/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["${POC_DIR:-/work}/gate/run_tests.py"]
    output:
      tests_exit_code: {type: number}
      tests_failed: {type: number}
      artifact_sha256: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: tamper

  # Between measurement and decision, the artifact changes — exactly what a review agent
  # with Edit tools could do, or any concurrent writer.
  - name: tamper
    type: script
    command: sh
    args: ["-c", "printf '\n# tampered after measurement\n' >> ${POC_DIR:-/work}/fixture/src/slugify.py; printf '{\"tampered\": true}\n'"]
    output:
      tampered: {type: boolean}
    routes:
      - to: verify_artifact

  # Decision-time re-measurement (the G1 fix).
  - name: verify_artifact
    type: script
    command: "${POC_PY:-/home/agent/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["${POC_DIR:-/work}/gate/verify_artifact.py", "{{ test.output.artifact_sha256 }}"]
    output:
      artifact_sha256_at_decision: {type: string}
      artifact_matches_tested: {type: boolean}
    routes:
      - to: collect_evidence

  - name: collect_evidence
    type: set
    values:
      tests: "{exit_code: {{ test.output.tests_exit_code }}, failed: {{ test.output.tests_failed }}}"
      review: "{verdict: PASS}"
      artifact: "{sha256: {{ test.output.artifact_sha256 }}, matches_tested: {{ verify_artifact.output.artifact_matches_tested }}}"
      governance: "{status: APPROVED, bound_to_target: true}"
    routes:
      - to: gate

  - name: gate
    type: script
    command: "${POC_PY:-/home/agent/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["${POC_DIR:-/work}/gate/gate.py"]
    stdin: "{{ collect_evidence.output | tojson }}"
    output:
      decision: {type: string}
      reason: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: preserve

  - name: preserve
    type: script
    command: "${POC_PY:-/home/agent/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["${POC_DIR:-/work}/gate/preserve_evidence.py"]
    stdin: "{{ collect_evidence.output | tojson }}"
    output:
      preserved_dir: {type: string}
      event_logs_copied: {type: number}
    routes:
      - to: $end

output:
  decision: "{{ gate.output.decision }}"
  digest_at_measurement: "{{ test.output.artifact_sha256 }}"
  digest_at_decision: "{{ verify_artifact.output.artifact_sha256_at_decision }}"
  reason: "{{ gate.output.reason }}"
  preserved: "{{ preserve.output.preserved_dir }}"
